_comment: Edit food card text here. correctAnswer must be one of: dog, cat, both, neither, ask-grown-up. image path is under public/assets/.

imageAlt.zhHant: 乾淨盤子上的清煮雞胸肉塊
imageAlt.en: Pieces of plain cooked chicken breast on a clean plate

preparation.zhHant: 完全煮熟，冇骨頭、冇皮、冇調味、冇醬汁，已放涼且新鮮。
preparation.en: Fully cooked, no bones, no skin, no seasoning, no sauce, still cool and fresh.

clues.zhHant: 骨頭可能會傷害寵物。
clues.en: Bones can hurt pets.

clues.zhHant: 鹽、洋蔥同大蒜醬料並不安全。
clues.en: Salt, onion and garlic sauces are not safe.

clues.zhHant: 大人同意時，狗同貓都可以分享清煮的肉。
clues.en: Both dogs and cats can share plain cooked meat when a grown-up says yes.

explanation.zhHant: 冇骨冇調味嘅清煮雞肉，狗同貓都食得——但要大人先話事。
explanation.en: Plain cooked chicken with no bones or seasoning can be okay for dogs and cats — but only when a grown-up says yes.

imageAlt.zhHant: 一顆生洋蔥同切好的洋蔥塊
imageAlt.en: A whole raw onion and chopped onion pieces

preparation.zhHant: 生的、切碎的，冇烹調，也冇同其他材料混合。
preparation.en: Raw, chopped, no cooking, no other ingredients mixed in.

clues.zhHant: 洋蔥可能會讓寵物很不舒服。
clues.en: Onions can make pets feel very sick.

clues.zhHant: 剩菜裡就算煮過的洋蔥也有問題。
clues.en: Even cooked onion in leftovers is a problem.

clues.zhHant: 呢不是狗或貓的點心。
clues.en: This is not a treat for dogs or cats.

explanation.zhHant: 洋蔥唔可以畀毛孩食——記住呢樣就夠。擺低佢，話畀大人知。
explanation.en: Onion is not safe for dogs or cats. Set it aside and tell a grown-up.

imageAlt.zhHant: 冇調味嘅軟熟紅蘿蔔片
imageAlt.en: Soft cooked carrot slices without seasoning

preparation.zhHant: 蒸至軟熟後放涼，冇牛油、冇鹽、冇蜜糖釉。
preparation.en: Steamed until soft, cooled, no butter, no salt, no honey glaze.

clues.zhHant: 軟軟的小塊比較好咬。
clues.en: Soft pieces are easier to chew.

clues.zhHant: 狗常常喜歡清淡的胡蘿蔔。
clues.en: Dogs often enjoy plain carrot.

clues.zhHant: 貓通常比較鍾意肉類食物，紅蘿蔔不是貓的首選。
clues.en: Cats usually prefer meaty foods, so carrot is not a cat favourite.

explanation.zhHant: 紅蘿蔔蒸到軟，冇鹽冇油。大人話得，狗狗食得開心；貓寧願食肉。
explanation.en: Soft, plain carrot is a good snack for dogs when a grown-up says yes. Cats would rather have meat.

imageAlt.en: A small cluster of fresh purple grapes

preparation.zhHant: 新鮮整顆提子，洗好咗，未去梗。
preparation.en: Fresh whole grapes, washed, no stems removed yet.

clues.zhHant: 我哋看不到每樣材料。
clues.en: We cannot see every ingredient.

clues.zhHant: 盤中剩菜可能有洋蔥、鹽或醬汁。
clues.en: Plate scraps may include onion, salt or sauce.

clues.zhHant: 我哋睇唔到／唔清楚就要問大人。
clues.en: When information is missing, ask a grown-up.

explanation.zhHant: 提子同提子乾可以令狗腎衰竭，而且冇一個安全份量可以估。貓食咗也可能腸胃唔舒服——所以所有毛孩都要遠離提子，同埋話畀大人知。
explanation.en: Grapes and raisins can cause kidney failure in dogs, and there is no safe amount to guess. Cats can also get a sore stomach from them — so keep grapes away from every pet and tell a grown-up.

imageAlt.zhHant: 一碗蓋著的混合剩菜，成分不明
imageAlt.en: A covered bowl of mixed leftovers with unknown ingredients

preparation.zhHant: 蓋著的混合剩菜。標籤缺失。氣味同成分都不清楚。
preparation.en: Covered mixed leftovers. Label is missing. Smell and ingredients are unknown.

clues.zhHant: 我哋看不到每樣材料。
clues.en: We cannot see every ingredient.

clues.zhHant: 盤中剩菜可能有洋蔥、鹽或醬汁。
clues.en: Plate scraps may include onion, salt or sauce.

clues.zhHant: 睇唔清楚，先問大人。
clues.en: When information is missing, ask a grown-up.

explanation.zhHant: 碗蓋住咗，我哋睇唔到入面有咩。最安全嘅答案係：問大人。寧願問，好過估。
explanation.en: We can't tell what's in this bowl, so the safe answer is: ask a grown-up. Better to ask than to guess.

imageAlt.zhHant: 去骨後的清煮白魚肉片
imageAlt.en: Flaked plain cooked white fish without bones

preparation.zhHant: 完全煮熟，仔細去骨，冇油、冇檸檬牛油，已放涼。
preparation.en: Fully cooked, carefully deboned, no oil, no lemon butter, cooled.

clues.zhHant: 一定要去掉骨頭。
clues.en: Bones must be removed.

clues.zhHant: 大人同意時，清淡魚肉可能適合貓同狗。
clues.en: Plain fish can suit cats and dogs when a grown-up approves.

clues.zhHant: 餐廳調味魚同清煮魚不一樣。
clues.en: Seasoned restaurant fish is not the same as plain fish.

explanation.zhHant: 大人檢查後，去骨嘅清煮魚可能適合狗同貓。
explanation.en: Plain, boneless cooked fish can be okay for dogs and cats after a grown-up checks.

imageAlt.zhHant: 餐巾上的一塊朱古力布朗尼
imageAlt.en: A square chocolate brownie on a napkin

preparation.zhHant: 烤焗朱古力甜品，有糖、可可同牛油。
preparation.en: Baked chocolate dessert with sugar, cocoa and butter.

clues.zhHant: 朱古力可能讓寵物病得很重。
clues.en: Chocolate can make pets very ill.

clues.zhHant: 甜品是人吃的，不是寵物食物。
clues.en: Sweet desserts are people food, not pet food.

clues.zhHant: 即使一小塊也應該留給人。
clues.en: Even a small piece should stay with people.

explanation.zhHant: 朱古力對狗同貓都不安全。把布朗尼留給人，如果寵物可能吃了，要告訴大人。
explanation.en: Chocolate is not safe for dogs or cats. Save the brownie for people and tell a grown-up if a pet might have eaten some.

imageAlt.zhHant: 打開的吞拿魚罐頭，標籤看不清
imageAlt.en: An open tin of tuna with an unreadable label

preparation.zhHant: 已打開的罐頭。標籤撕破。不知道是浸水、浸油還是調味醬。
preparation.en: Open tin. Label torn. Unknown if packed in water, oil or flavoured sauce.

clues.zhHant: 油同醬汁會改變食唔食得。
clues.en: Oil and flavoured sauces change what is safe.

clues.zhHant: 我哋看不到完整標籤。
clues.en: We cannot read the full label.

clues.zhHant: 資料不足就要先問大人。
clues.en: Missing information means ask a grown-up.

explanation.zhHant: 唔知罐入面係水、油定醬汁——餵之前先問大人。
explanation.en: We can't tell if this tin holds water, oil or sauce — so ask a grown-up before feeding.

imageAlt.zhHant: 盤子上的原味嫩豆腐塊，冇調味
imageAlt.en: Plain firm tofu cubes on a plate, no seasoning

preparation.zhHant: 原味板豆腐，切小塊，冇鹽、冇醬油、冇辣椒，新鮮放涼。
preparation.en: Plain firm tofu, cut into small cubes, no salt, no soy sauce, no chilli, cool and fresh.

clues.zhHant: 冇調味的豆腐，同滷味豆腐不一樣。
clues.en: Plain tofu is not the same as seasoned braised tofu.

clues.zhHant: 狗有時可以吃一點原味豆腐，但要先問大人。
clues.en: Dogs can sometimes share a little plain tofu when a grown-up says yes.

clues.zhHant: 貓寧願食肉，豆腐不是貓的首選。
clues.en: Cats would rather have meat — so tofu is not a cat favourite.

explanation.zhHant: 原味豆腐冇鹽冇醬油冇辣椒。大人話得，狗狗食得開心；貓寧願食肉。
explanation.en: Plain tofu is a good snack for dogs when a grown-up says yes. Cats would rather have meat.

imageAlt.zhHant: 盤子上的一片生三文魚刺身
imageAlt.en: A piece of raw salmon fillet on a plate

preparation.zhHant: 生的三文魚片，未煮熟，冇醬汁，但處理過程不明。
preparation.en: Raw salmon fillet, uncooked, no sauce, handling history unknown.

clues.zhHant: 生魚可能有寄生蟲、細菌，同埋會破壞維他命B1嘅物質。
clues.en: Raw fish can carry parasites, bacteria, and something that destroys vitamin B1.

clues.zhHant: 清煮熟透的魚，同生魚不一樣。
clues.en: Fully cooked plain fish is not the same as raw fish.

clues.zhHant: 不要把壽司或生魚片直接給寵物。
clues.en: Do not offer sushi or raw fish to pets on your own.

explanation.zhHant: 生魚唔啱狗同貓食。可能有寄生蟲同細菌，仲有一種嘢會破壞維他命B1——貓最容易受影響。擺低佢，去叫大人嚟睇。
explanation.en: Raw fish isn't safe for dogs or cats. It can carry parasites and bacteria, and something in it destroys vitamin B1 — cats get hurt the most. Leave it on the plate and get a grown-up to check.

preparation.zhHant: 人吃的甜糖果，有糖分，可能含不明添加物。
preparation.en: Sweet people candy with sugar; additives may be unknown.

clues.zhHant: 糖果是人吃的甜食，不是寵物食物。
clues.en: Candy is a people sweet, not pet food.

clues.zhHant: 無糖香口膠同無糖糖果可能含木糖醇，對狗非常危險。
clues.en: Sugar-free gum and sugar-free candy can contain xylitol, which is very dangerous for dogs.

clues.zhHant: 即使一小顆也不要自己給寵物。
clues.en: Do not offer even a small piece to a pet on your own.

explanation.zhHant: 糖果唔係毛孩食物。無糖香口膠同無糖糖果可能含木糖醇，對狗好危險——毛孩食咗就即刻話畀大人知。
explanation.en: Candy is not pet food. Sugar-free gum and candy can contain xylitol, which is very dangerous for dogs — if a pet eats any, tell a grown-up straight away.

imageAlt.en: A fresh watermelon slice with no seeds shown

preparation.zhHant: 新鮮西瓜果肉，已去籽、去皮，冇糖或鹽。
preparation.en: Fresh watermelon flesh only — no seeds, no rind, no sugar or salt.

clues.zhHant: 籽同綠皮不要給寵物。
clues.en: Seeds and green rind should not go to pets.

clues.zhHant: 純果肉、大人同意時，狗同貓都可能可以分享一點。
clues.en: Plain flesh can be okay for dogs and cats when a grown-up says yes.

clues.zhHant: 呢不是正餐，只是檢查練習。
clues.en: This is not a meal — only an inspection practice.

explanation.zhHant: 去核去皮嘅西瓜肉，大人話得狗同貓都可以試少少——但貓唔需要水果，一小口就夠，唔係一碗。
explanation.en: Seedless, rind-free watermelon flesh is safe for dogs and cats to taste when a grown-up agrees — but cats do not need fruit, so one small taste is the limit, not a bowl.

imageAlt.zhHant: 一小碗清煮玉米粒（已離芯）
imageAlt.en: A small bowl of plain cooked corn kernels off the cob

preparation.zhHant: 清煮玉米粒，已從玉米芯取下，冇牛油、冇鹽。
preparation.en: Plain cooked corn kernels taken off the cob, no butter, no salt.

clues.zhHant: 整條玉米芯可能卡住寵物，很危險。
clues.en: A whole corn cob can be dangerous if a pet chews it.

clues.zhHant: 狗有時可以吃一點清淡玉米粒。
clues.en: Dogs can sometimes share a little plain corn kernels.

clues.zhHant: 貓寧願食肉，玉米不是貓的首選。
clues.en: Cats would rather have meat — so corn is not a cat favourite.

explanation.zhHant: 離芯冇調味嘅清煮玉米粒，大人話得可以當狗嘅點心。玉米芯本身對狗同貓都危險——會塞住腸道。貓寧願食肉。
explanation.en: Plain cooked kernels off the cob are a good snack for dogs when a grown-up agrees. The cob itself is dangerous for dogs and cats — it can block the gut. Cats would rather have meat.

imageAlt.zhHant: 去皮的綠色奇異果切半
imageAlt.en: Peeled green kiwi fruit cut in half

preparation.zhHant: 新鮮奇異果，已去皮切塊，冇糖。
preparation.en: Fresh kiwi, peeled and cut, no sugar added.

clues.zhHant: 外皮通常要去掉。
clues.en: The fuzzy skin is usually removed.

clues.zhHant: 狗有時可以吃一點原味奇異果。
clues.en: Dogs can sometimes share a little plain kiwi.

clues.zhHant: 貓通常不需要呢種水果。
clues.en: Cats usually do not need this kind of fruit.

explanation.zhHant: 去皮嘅原味奇異果，大人話得可以當狗嘅點心。貓寧願食肉。
explanation.en: Peeled plain kiwi is a good snack for dogs when a grown-up agrees. Cats would rather have meat.

imageAlt.zhHant: 整個牛油果同切開見核的半顆
imageAlt.en: A whole avocado and a cut half with the pit

preparation.zhHant: 新鮮牛油果，連皮同果核一起在盤上。
preparation.en: Fresh avocado on a plate, including skin and pit nearby.

clues.zhHant: 對狗同貓來說，牛油果只是輕微腸胃不適。
clues.en: For dogs and cats, avocado is only mildly upsetting.

clues.zhHant: 危險的是果核同果皮——可以塞住腸道。
clues.en: The danger is the pit and skin — they can block the gut.

clues.zhHant: 呢不是寵物點心——先問大人。
clues.en: This is not a pet treat — ask a grown-up.

explanation.zhHant: 牛油果唔係毛孩點心。對狗同貓只會輕微腸胃唔舒服，但果核同果皮可以塞住腸道——唔好畀毛孩掂到，同話畀大人知。
explanation.en: Avocado is not a pet treat. For dogs and cats it is only mildly upsetting, but the pit and skin can block the gut — keep it away from pets and tell a grown-up.
